_readme: Copy this file to banks/<semester>/<course>.json, replace its contents and delete _readme.
Then list the course in banks/catalog.json and run: python3 tools/build.py
Text fields are LaTeX-flavoured plain text: $...$ is inline math and $$...$$ is display math, typeset by KaTeX.
Every backslash is doubled in JSON, so \frac is written \\frac.

meta.note: Anything a learner should know about the scope of this bank.

questions.question: Every bounded sequence of real numbers has a convergent subsequence.
questions.explanation: 这是 Bolzano--Weierstrass 定理。有界性不能去掉：$a_n=n$ 没有收敛子列。

questions.question: The figure shows the graph of $f(x)=x^2$ on $[-1,1]$. What is the shaded area $\int_{-1}^{1}x^2\,dx$?

figure.caption: The graph of $f(x)=x^2$.

questions.question: Which of the following sets are countable? Select \emph{all} that apply.
questions.explanation: $\mathbb{Q}$ 与 $\mathbb{Z}\times\mathbb{Z}$ 都能与 $\mathbb{N}$ 建立双射；$\mathbb{R}$ 不可数（Cantor 对角线论证）。

questions.question: $\lim_{x\to0}\dfrac{\sin x}{x}=$ ____ and $\lim_{n\to\infty}\left(1+\tfrac1n\right)^n=$ ____.
questions.explanation: 两个都是标准极限。第二个是 $e$ 的定义之一，$e\approx2.718$。
